doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving Lunceford, Lee and Lester Young's band, and Les Hite
summary: Asked about Les Hite, Young says he quit Lunceford in 1942, came west to join the Youngs' band, disliked the small band, and joined Les Hite.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: That was a good band, I came out to California and joined Les Hite‘s band.
Well, you said Floyd Ray, reminded me of other California.

Les Hite was a good band, man. When I came out, quit Jimmie Lunceford, and finally Gerald, we both quit the same year in ‘42. Gerald came to California, Lester Young and Lee Young formed a band and they knew I was in Dayton so they wanted

Snooky Young in that Young band. I came to California to join Lee and Lester Young‘s band and somehow I didn‘t want to play in a small band. I swear to God, I didn‘t want to play in a small band and I joined Floyd, I mean…
